name: Quintet
author: E. T. Carter
description: Five standing plane-wave trains cross at 72 degrees and sum into a decagonal quasicrystal, rendered as luminous iso-contours: nested rings around every interference centre interlock into the pentagon and ten-pointed-star tiling of a pattern that never quite repeats, an ornate woven brocade of glowing thread. The contour hue cycles by field level so each ring shimmers a different colour. Hash-scheduled strikes flood all five voices and they ring down at five separate rates, so the whole weave flares on a strike and recedes between blows while the phases slowly breathe. A five-voice sibling of Triad's three-train honeycomb.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: CSS-pixel scale of the star cells, from a fine quasicrystalline mesh down to a few large breathing rosettes.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between hash-scheduled strikes that re-flood and reseat the lattice.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: How long the five voices take to die away, stretching or shortening the star-to-fragment melt.

params.label: Skew
params.effect: Detunes two opposing voices so the quasicrystal slowly breathes through its inflation symmetry; zero locks a static five-fold pattern.
